title: Additivity of abstract run lengths
statement: For any register program $A$, oracle function $o$, input $x$, initial configuration $a$, and natural numbers $s,t$, running $A$ for $s+t$ steps from $a$ gives the same configuration as running it first for $s$ steps and then for $t$ more steps.
